messages:
alice_support: @customer_acme thanks for the report — we got the request id req_0a1b2c3. Can you paste the full response body you saw?

customer_acme: Pasting the exact payload we received ->
```
{
  \"items\": [
    {\"title\": \"Invoice #123\", \"body\": \"Amount: $10.00\"},
    **note**: \"Please review line items with finance\",
    {\"title\": \"Metadata\", \"body\": \"Generated by model v2\"}
  ]
}
```

customer_acme: Our parser fails with: "SyntaxError: Unexpected token * in JSON at position 58" and it's breaking their ingestion pipeline. This started around 2026-03-12 17:02 UTC.

alice_support: ugh, looks like the model injected markdown tokens outside of strings. @mike_engineer could this be a prompt/template edge case or a generation bug?

mike_engineer: Thanks, investigating. Which model and prompt are you using? Also did you set `json_mode` on the request?

customer_acme: Model: open-redwood/ff-2.1 (hosted). Call looked like:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"open-redwood/ff-2.1","json_mode":"structured","prompt":"..."}'
```

mike_engineer: Repro steps clear, thanks. Two quick asks: 1) can you attach the request id from your API logs (we have req_0a1b2c3 but need the exact sub-id if present), 2) can you confirm if this occurs consistently or intermittently?

customer_acme: It's intermittent — seen it ~3x in last 48h on high-volume runs. I attached the full raw response via DM to @alice_support.

sara_sre: tagging infra: could be a tokenization edge where markdown markers are emitted outside quotes when the model is asked to format sections. We should temporarily implement a defensive pre-parse that strips non-json tokens between top-level elements.

mike_engineer: Short-term workaround: switch to `json_mode: "permissive"` (this will return the same content but also include a `raw_text` field we can parse heuristically). Example:
```json
{"model":"open-redwood/ff-2.1","json_mode":"permissive","prompt":"..."}
```
Note: `permissive` still counts towards quota.

mike_engineer: Longer-term plan: I will add a parser hardening change to the inference edge that attempts to coerce interleaved tokens into strings (escape markdown markers) and then retry strict parse. If coercion fails, we will return structured `parse_error` with `raw_text` attached so clients can fallback.

alice_support: Customer asks for comms + expected ETA for a fix. SLA note: first engineering triage within 4h, patch rollout target 24-72h depending on risk.

mike_engineer: ETA: we can ship a conservative pre-parse in the next deploy window (2h) as a hotfix to reduce incidents. Full guardrails + prompt-template audit will be in the next release (72h). I'll post PR links when ready.

customer_acme: Appreciate it. For now we enabled `json_mode: permissive` and added a small pre-processor to regex-out `^\*\*[^\n]+\*\*:` occurrences. That reduced errors but not fully eliminated them.

mike_engineer: Thanks for the mitigation note — that regex is a good short-term patch: `s/\*\*[^\*]+\*\*\s*:/\"note\":/g` (apply only to top-level buffers!). We'll avoid changing customer-visible keys.

inc-bot: deploy triggered: hotfix/preparse-escape-md to edge nodes (sha: a1b2c3d)

mike_engineer: Hotfix deployed to canary. Monitoring logs for req_0a1b2c3 family. @sara_sre can you watch error-rate for structured parse failures in the next 60m?

sara_sre: watching now, will report back with delta. :eyes:

alice_support: I'll update Acme with the workaround + hotfix ETA and confirm once canary looks good. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
